scripts.setup-zsh-plugins: test -d ~/.powerlevel10k || git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/romkatv/powerlevel10k.git ~/.powerlevel10k && test -d ~/.zsh/zsh-autosuggestions || git clone https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions ~/.zsh/zsh-autosuggestions && test -d ~/.zsh/zsh-syntax-highlighting || git clone https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting.git ~/.zsh/zsh-syntax-highlighting
scripts.restore-zsh: npm run setup-zsh-plugins && cp ./zsh/.zshrc ~/.zshrc 2>/dev/null || true && cp ./zsh/.p10k.zsh ~/.p10k.zsh 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.restore-iterm: defaults write com.googlecode.iterm2 PrefsCustomFolder -string "$(pwd)/iterm2" && defaults write com.googlecode.iterm2 LoadPrefsFromCustomFolder -bool true
scripts.restore-vscode: xargs -n 1 code --install-extension < ./VSCode/extensions.txt 2>/dev/null || true && cp ./VSCode/{settings,keybindings}.json ~/Library/Application\ Support/Code/User/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.save-claude: mkdir -p ./claude/commands && cp ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md ./claude/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp ~/.claude/README.md ./claude/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp ~/.claude/commands/*.md ./claude/commands/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.restore-claude: mkdir -p ~/.claude/commands && cp ./claude/CLAUDE.md ~/.claude/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp ./claude/README.md ~/.claude/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp ./claude/commands/*.md ~/.claude/commands/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.restore-rectangle: killall Rectangle 2>/dev/null || true && defaults import com.knollsoft.Rectangle ./rectangle/com.knollsoft.Rectangle.plist && open -a Rectangle 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.save-macos: mkdir -p ./macos && defaults read com.apple.dock autohide-delay > ./macos/dock-delay 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.restore-macos: defaults write com.apple.dock autohide-delay -float 0 && defaults write com.apple.dock autohide-time-modifier -float 0 && killall Dock 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.save-all: npm run save-git && npm run save-zsh && npm run save-iterm && npm run save-vscode && npm run save-obsidian && npm run save-claude && npm run save-rectangle && npm run save-macos
scripts.restore-all: npm run restore-brew && npm run restore-git && npm run restore-zsh && npm run restore-iterm && npm run restore-vscode && npm run restore-obsidian && npm run restore-claude && npm run restore-rectangle && npm run restore-macos
